bead create --title "Define StateStore trait for persistence abstraction" --description "Create a Rust trait that abstracts state persistence operations, enabling pluggable backend implementations.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Define `StateStore` trait in src/scraper/state.rs with all required methods:
  - `get_state(&self, key: &str) -> Result<Option<State>>`
  - `set_state(&self, key: &str, state: &State) -> Result<()>`
  - `delete_state(&self, key: &str) -> Result<()>`
  - `list_keys(&self) -> Result<Vec<String>>`
  - `exists(&self, key: &str) -> Result<bool>`
  - `clear_all(&self) -> Result<()>`
  - `save(&self) -> Result<()>` (for backends that need explicit flush)
- Add comprehensive rustdoc comments explaining the contract for each method
- Include error type documentation (what errors each method can return)
- Add a simple unit test verifying the trait is object-safe (can be used as `dyn StateStore`)

## Notes
This trait becomes the foundation for all backend implementations. Focus on getting the method signatures and documentation right — no actual implementations yet." --label split-child
